name: Harvey
source:
Harvey is the leader of the Roachrist (a group of people who look after the Alicis) and he seems like a really tough guy but in reality, he’s very kind and really loves puppies too. Harvey is also a very friendly person and gets on well with everyone.

(from [url=http://liemyx.wordpress.com/2011/07/10/kago-no-naka-no-alicis-review/]Liemyx's Eroge Blog[/url])
